# Swooon

> > Swooon is a romance book discovery platform featuring curated reviews, spice meters, and trope-based recommendations across contemporary, YA, historical, and fantasy romance subgenres.

The site provides detailed book reviews with purchase links to Bookshop and Amazon, helping readers discover romance novels by trope (enemies-to-lovers, second-chance, friends-to-lovers), heat level, and subgenre. Reviews feature authors like Sloane St. James, Rina Kent, Emily Charlotte, and Lily Chu across diverse romance categories.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary Romance
- Enemies-to-Lovers
- Second-Chance Romance
- Young Adult Romance
- Friends-to-Lovers
- Spice Meter
- Sports Romance
- Queer Romance
- Rom-Com
- College Romance
- Forced Proximity
- Slow Burn
- Small Town Romance
- Romantasy
- Historical Romance

## Contemporary & Rom-Com Romance

- [Drop Dead - Lily Chu](https://www.swooon.com/book/drop-dead): Contemporary rom-com with enemies-to-lovers trope by Lily Chu
- [Meet Me at the Lake - Carley Fortune](https://www.swooon.com/book/meet-me-at-the-lake): Lakeside second-chance romance by Carley Fortune
- [In My Boxes and Breakups Era - Lola B. Marie](https://www.swooon.com/book/in-my-boxes-and-breakups-era): Second-chance romance with Jo & UPS driver Cole
- [Curvy Girl Summer - Danielle Allen](https://www.swooon.com/book/curvy-girl-summer): Friends-to-lovers contemporary romance celebrating body positivity
- [Just Friends - Haley Pham](https://www.swooon.com/book/just-friends): Friends-to-lovers second-chance romance with Blair & Declan
- [Alice Chen's Reality Check - Kara Loo & Jennifer Young](https://www.swooon.com/book/alice-chens-reality-check): Reality show rom-com with murder mystery twist

## Sports & Action Romance

- [Fight - Sloane St. James](https://www.swooon.com/book/fight): Sky Ridge Hotshots enemies-to-lovers firefighter romance
- [Heart Check - Emily Charlotte](https://www.swooon.com/book/heart-check): YA hockey romance with Luke & Harper's enemies-to-lovers story
- [Double Apex - Josie Juniper](https://www.swooon.com/book/double-apex): F1 romance with engineer Phaedra & driver Cosmin

## Dark & College Romance

- [God of Malice - Rina Kent](https://www.swooon.com/book/god-of-malice): Dark college romance with Killian & Glyndon
- [Missing White Woman - Kellye Garrett](https://www.swooon.com/book/missing-white-woman): Romance thriller with Bree Wright solving murder mystery

## Young Adult Romance

- [Don't Let It Break Your Heart - Maggie Horne](https://www.swooon.com/book/dont-let-it-break-your-heart): YA queer romance exploring identity and first love
- [Falling Like Leaves - Misty Wilson](https://www.swooon.com/book/falling-like-leaves): YA second-chance romance in Bramble Falls with Ellis & Cooper

## Queer & LGBTQ+ Romance

- [Husband of the Year - M.A. Wardell](https://www.swooon.com/book/husband-of-the-year): Queer romance from Teachers Love series
- [Don't Let It Break Your Heart - Maggie Horne](https://www.swooon.com/book/dont-let-it-break-your-heart): YA queer romance by Maggie Horne

## Fantasy & Historical Romance

- [Extraordinary Quests for Amateur Witches - Kayla Cottingham](https://www.swooon.com/book/extraordinary-quests-for-amateur-witches): Queer YA romantasy with witch Kieran
- [Her Hidden Fire - Cliodhna O'Sullivan](https://www.swooon.com/book/her-hidden-fire): Romantasy friends-to-lovers romance
- [A Most Worthy Husband - Faye Delacour](https://www.swooon.com/book/a-most-worthy-husband): Historical romance from Lucky Ladies of London series
- [Her Time Traveling Duke - Bryn Donovan](https://www.swooon.com/book/her-time-traveling-duke): Time-travel romance with museum employee Rose & Duke Henry

## Holiday Romance

- [Eight Nights to Win Her Heart - Miri White](https://www.swooon.com/book/eight-nights-to-win-her-heart): Hanukkah holiday romance with Andie & Leo
